notes: Not automated: [On Play] If your Leader has the {Animal Kingdom Pirates} type, look at 7 cards from the top of your deck; reveal a total of 2 [Plague Rounds] or [Ice Oni] cards and add them to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
